rows.label: bf02220100_0010
rows.name: Delicious! It's delicious, Homura!

rows.label: bf02220100_0020
rows.name:
Yum-yum, mo! My cheeks might
fall right off, mo!

rows.label: bf02220100_0030
rows.name: This is delicious.

rows.label: bf02220100_0040
rows.name: I haven't eaten this well in 120 years!

rows.label: bf02220100_0050
rows.name: Glad you liked it!

rows.label: bf02220100_0060
rows.name:
It seems like I did okay... I was worried I'd
have gotten a little rusty over the years.

rows.label: bf02220100_0070
rows.name: Far from rusty, this is the best, Homura!

rows.label: bf02220100_0080
rows.name:
But it's strange, mo. Homura-chan,
you're a Blade who uses fire, mo?

rows.label: bf02220100_0090
rows.name:
Even when that water pipe broke earlier,
you could still use fire, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0100
rows.name:
Come to think of it, you're right. That
Kagutsuchi, the imperial Blade...

rows.label: bf02220100_0110
rows.name:
She used fire abilities
just like Homura,

rows.label: bf02220100_0120
rows.name: Her power dropped considerably.

rows.label: bf02220100_0130
rows.name: Is that so unusual?

rows.label: bf02220100_0140
rows.name:
This world has elemental power
called ether, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0150
rows.name: Fire, water, wind, and lots of others, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0160
rows.name:
Drivers and Blades both draw their power
from this ether, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0170
rows.name: And fire is weak against water, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0180
rows.name:
That's why that Blade lady got soaked
and powered down, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0190
rows.name:
But Homura and I were able to
use our powers with no problem.

rows.label: bf02220100_0200
rows.name: Indeed. They were unaffected.

rows.label: bf02220100_0210
rows.name: Why, mo?

rows.label: bf02220100_0220
rows.name: Um, well, my element isn't fire so...

rows.label: bf02220100_0230
rows.name:
Mo-mo-mo! If you're not fire, how can you
use fire power, mo?

rows.label: bf02220100_0240
rows.name:
Th-that may be a little
complicated to explain...

rows.label: bf02220100_0250
rows.name:
Why, mo? Those complicated circumstances
sound really interesting, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0260
rows.name: Ah, well, u-um, I, it...

rows.label: bf02220100_0270
rows.name:
Knock it off, Tora. Can't you see
you're making her uncomfortable?

rows.label: bf02220100_0280
rows.name: Mooo...

rows.label: bf02220100_0290
rows.name:
Everyone has things they'd
rather not talk about. Right?

rows.label: bf02220100_0300
rows.name:
I'm sorry. When the time comes that
I can tell you, I promise I will.

rows.label: bf02220100_0310
rows.name: Don't worry about it.

rows.label: bf02220100_0320
rows.name:
Right now, we need to think
about how to rescue Nia.

rows.label: bf02220100_0330
rows.name:
First we need to go into town
and gather information, mo.

rows.label: bf02220100_0340
rows.name:
Hmm... But we may already be
wanted ourselves by now.

rows.label: bf02220100_0350
rows.name: Homura especially stands out.

rows.label: bf02220100_0360
rows.name: I'm really sorry.

rows.label: bf02220100_0370
rows.name: It's okay, mo. Tora has a good idea, mo.
